machine learning.answer: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data without being explicitly programmed.

artificial intelligence.answer: Artificial intelligence is the simulation of human intelligence processes by computer systems, including learning, reasoning, and self-correction.

deep learning.answer: Deep learning is a subfield of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers to model complex patterns in data.

neural network.answer: A neural network is a computing system inspired by the biological neural networks in animal brains, composed of interconnected nodes that process information.

chatnnl.answer: ChatNNL is a statistical chatbot engine that builds language models from text corpora using n-gram statistics. It uses no neural networks, no deep learning, and no GPU.

n-gram.answer: An n-gram is a contiguous sequence of n items from a given sample of text. ChatNNL uses bigrams, trigrams, fourgrams, and fivegrams for generation.

language model.answer: A language model is a statistical model that assigns probabilities to sequences of words. ChatNNL builds one from n-gram counts over a corpus.

python.answer: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its readability and simplicity. It is widely used in data science, machine learning, web development, and automation.
disadvantages: Slower execution speed compared to compiled languages
Global interpreter lock limits true multithreading

javascript.answer: JavaScript is a programming language that runs in web browsers and on servers through Node.js. It is the most widely used language for building interactive web pages.
advantages: Runs everywhere, from browsers to servers
disadvantages: Dynamic typing can cause runtime errors

rust.answer: Rust is a systems programming language focused on safety, speed, and concurrency. It prevents many common programming errors at compile time without a garbage collector.

sql.answer: SQL is a domain specific language used for managing and querying relational databases.

database.answer: A database is an organized collection of structured information stored electronically. A relational database stores data in tables with rows and columns.

git.answer: Git is a distributed version control system for tracking changes in source code during software development.

github.answer: GitHub is a platform for hosting and collaborating on Git repositories, with features for code review, issue tracking, and CI/CD.

docker.answer: Docker is a platform for building, running, and sharing containerized applications.

kubernetes.answer: Kubernetes is an open source system for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.

http.answer: HTTP is the protocol used to transfer data on the World Wide Web.

dns.answer: DNS translates human readable domain names into IP addresses.

encryption.answer: Encryption is the process of converting information into a code to prevent unauthorized access.

blockchain.answer: A blockchain is a distributed ledger that records transactions across many computers in a way that is difficult to alter retroactively.

photosynthesis.answer: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert sunlight into chemical energy, producing oxygen as a byproduct.

gravity.answer: Gravity is the force by which a planet or other body draws objects toward its center.

speed of light.answer: The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately three hundred million meters per second.

water.answer: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius and freezes at zero degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.

algorithm.answer: An algorithm is a finite sequence of well defined instructions used to solve a problem or perform a computation.

data structure.answer: A data structure is a way of organizing data in memory to enable efficient access and modification.

binary search.answer: Binary search finds a target value in a sorted array by repeatedly halving the search range. Its time complexity is logarithmic in the size of the input.

recursion.answer: Recursion is a programming technique where a function calls itself to solve smaller subproblems.

cloud computing.answer: Cloud computing is the delivery of computing services over the Internet, including storage, processing, and networking.

container.answer: A container packages an application and its dependencies into a single unit that can run consistently across environments.

cache.answer: A cache stores frequently accessed data to reduce latency and improve performance.

firewall.answer: A firewall monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on security rules.

vpn.answer: A VPN creates a secure encrypted connection over a public network.

unit test.answer: A unit test verifies the behavior of individual functions or methods in isolation.

debugging.answer: Debugging is the process of finding and fixing defects in software.

refactoring.answer: Refactoring improves the internal structure of code without changing its external behavior.

technical debt.answer: Technical debt is the cost of additional rework caused by choosing an easy solution now instead of a better approach that would take longer.
